title: 88 Nic Citrus Nicotine Pouches
description: 88Nic Citrus tastes sharp and lively, blending bright Citrus notes with a gentle sweetness for a clean, zesty profile. A subtle, cooling edge keeps the flavour clear from start to finish. Each pouch sits neatly under the lip, releasing nicotine gradually without smoke, vapour or odour. Each can includes 20 pouches. Choose from 6mg (Medium) for a softer release or 12mg (Extra Strong) for a more pronounced dose. The format is simple to use and designed for everyday convenience. Nicotine Ranges: Medium - 6mg this is best for regular users. Extra Strong - 12mg this How to Use: Nicotine Pouches Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
